title: Thai Gentle Noodle Dish
description: A simple and comforting Thai-inspired noodle dish made with gentle noodles and a variety of savory flavors. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Gentle noodles
ingredients.notes: Choose a gentle, low-carb noodle variety

ingredients.name: Slovakian vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral-tasting oil for sautéing

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the onion for even cooking

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic for maximum flavor

ingredients.name: Mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Slice the mushrooms into thin strips

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a low-sodium soy sauce for added depth

ingredients.name: Slovakian dish seasoning
ingredients.notes: Add a touch of Slovakian flair with this unique seasoning

instructions: Cook the gentle noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat the Slovakian vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and sauté for 3-4 minutes, or until the onion is translucent.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Pour in the soy sauce and Slovakian dish seasoning, and stir to combine. Cook for 1-2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce and vegetables.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions or sesame seeds if desired.
